title: Mind lamp turns green during the episode

tellings.quote: So, when you multiply these probabilities, you get a 2% chance that we got green on the first try within the first 30 seconds of trying.

plain: On a 2021 episode about a CIA program that used psychics as spies, podcast host Jesse Michels tells of a "mind lamp" in Princeton, New Jersey. The lamp is a device said to respond to people's intentions, and he connects it to a researcher named Herb Metts. Michels says the lamp turned green on the first try, within the first 30 seconds, and by his math the odds of that were about 2%. If that is true, it would hint that the mind can affect a machine.
